user.title: Add observation area
user.description: Events within the circle are shown.

data_description.name: For example “Commute”. Used in entity names.
data_description.location: Move the marker and drag the circle. Maximum radius: 100 km.
data_description.sources: Which sources to show in this area, e.g. only the motorway for a commute.
data_description.roads: Which motorways to consider in this area. Only their events within the circle are shown. (The Autobahn API always returns a whole motorway, hence this selection.) Only relevant if the Autobahn source is selected.

directions.title: Directions of travel
directions.description: Only show motorway events in these directions. Leave empty for all directions. Events without a clear direction (e.g. junction ramps) are always shown. On a commute the direction name can change at a motorway junction, e.g. “Singen -> Stuttgart” and then “Stuttgart -> Heilbronn”.
